title: 公司完成非标自动化定制装备生产线扩产，首批装备交付
titleEn: Company Completes Custom Non-standard Automation Equipment Production Line Expansion, First Batch Delivered
summary: 伴随着新能源氢能汽车及商业航天火箭壳体织造需求的激增，公司完成了非标定制高端自动化装备产线的新一轮扩容改建，中试产能提升 100%。首批为汽车轻量化定制的三维纺织生产线已如期装箱起运。
summaryEn: With the surge in demand for new energy hydrogen vehicle 和 commercial aerospace rocket casing braiding, the company completed a new round of expansion for its custom high-end automation equipment production line, boosting pilot capacity by 100%. The first batch of 3D textile production lines customized for automotive lightweighting has been packed 和 shipped on schedule.
content:
伴随着新能源氢能汽车及商业航天火箭壳体织造需求的激增，公司完成了非标定制高端自动化装备产线的新一轮扩容改建，中试产能提升 100%。首批为汽车轻量化定制的三维纺织生产线已如期装箱起运。

在本次扩产交付仪式上，公司宣布第一期全自动异形承压部件编织产线正式交付客户方。该产线集成多关节协作机械臂、双温控真空辅助注塑成型（RTM）设备及云路自研智能排线控制系统，可实现碳纤维丝束从放卷、骨架三维织造、机械手自动转移到真空注塑成型的一体化闭环生产，人工操作成本降低 70% 以上，良品率提升至 99.2%。该项目的顺利交付标志着云路复材从「设备研发商」向「产线级方案交付商」的成功转型。
contentEn:
With the surge in demand for new energy hydrogen vehicle 和 commercial aerospace rocket casing braiding, the company completed a new round of expansion for its custom high-end automation equipment production line, boosting pilot capacity by 100%. The first batch of 3D textile production lines customized for automotive lightweighting has been packed 和 shipped on schedule.

At the expansion delivery ceremony, the company announced the official delivery of the first-phase fully automated irregular pressure-bearing component braiding production line to customers. The line integrates multi-joint collaborative robotic arms, dual-temperature-controlled vacuum-assisted RTM injection molding equipment, 和 Yunlu's independently developed intelligent wire routing control system, achieving integrated closed-loop production from carbon fiber tow unwinding, 3D framework braiding, robotic automatic transfer, to vacuum injection molding. Labor costs reduced by over 70%, yield rate increased to 99.2%. The successful delivery marks Yunlu Composites' transformation from 'equipment R&D provider' to 'production line solution provider'.
